'''[[Maccabi (sports)|Maccabi]] Sha'arayim''' ({{langx|he|מכבי שעריים}}) is an Israeli [[football club]] from the city [[Rehovot]], currently playing in [[Liga Alef]].

The club spent the past seven seasons in the top division from 1963 to 1969, and a single season in [[1985–86 Liga Leumit|1985–86]]."}}
